observation: Very round golden tan boar, broad cream round eyes with small black pupils, ochre irregular round patches, heavy dark smooth outlines, broad golden snout with two long dark nostrils and two large curved ivory cheek tusks. Two small triangular ears belong on the TORSO upper shoulders as in the source atlas, not duplicated on detached face. Four very short solid tan feet without claws or invented black shoes. One tiny smooth pointed tan tail, not curled, tufted or ringed. No helmet, mane, crown, saddle, armor or dorsal spikes.
